#include <iostream>
#include <string>

class Analyzer {
public:
    int maxLength;
    int countLength;
    int countWord;
    int checker;
    int checkerInside;
    bool isInWordOut;
    bool isInWordIn;
    bool isInside;

    Analyzer() : maxLength(0), countLength(0), countWord(0), checker(0), checkerInside(0),
                 isInWordOut(false), isInWordIn(false), isInside(false) {}

    void feed(char c) {
        if (c == '(') {
            isInside = true;
            checkerInside++;
            if (maxLength < countLength) maxLength = countLength;
            countLength = 0;
            isInWordOut = false;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            isInside = false;
            checkerInside = 0;
            if (checker > 0) {
                countWord++;
                checker = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (checkerInside > 0) isInside = true;
        }

        if (c != ')' && c != '(') {
            if (!isInside) {
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (maxLength < countLength) maxLength = countLength;
                    countLength = 0;
                    isInWordOut = false;
                } else {
                    isInWordOut = true;
                }
                if (isInWordOut) countLength++;
            } else {
                isInWordOut = false;
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (checker > 0) countWord++;
                    checker = 0;
                    isInWordIn = false;
                } else {
                    isInWordIn = true;
                }
                if (isInWordIn) checker++;
            }
        }
    }

    std::string result() {
        if (maxLength < countLength) maxLength = countLength;
        return std::to_string(maxLength) + " " + std::to_string(countWord);
    }
};

int main() {
    int length;
    std::cin >> length;
    std::cin.ignore();
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    Analyzer analyzer;
    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        analyzer.feed(str[i]);
    }
    std::cout << analyzer.result() << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
